arcaneTower.name: Arcane Tower
arcaneTower.description: (allows a hero to redistribute his or her primary skill points)

rewards.message:
A ghost floats down a staircase and glides up to you. It floats there, flickering, regarding you. At last it speaks. "It is well that you came here, traveller. I can help you."

The ghost continues. "I can make you strong, give you power - perhaps as much power as I have! But it will cost you dearly. Today I can give you skill at attack... in return, I require defense. One for one. Are you interested?"
rewards.description: This day allows to redistribute Defense for Attack
